title: Map & Location Drilldown
prompt:
PAGE 0 & PAGE 5 COMBINED: Map Landing, GPS Location Permission Flow & Interactive Location Drilldown (Past · Now · Future).

Mobile tactical map interface optimized for meteorologists and emergency operators:
1. Full-Bleed Dark Tactical India Map (65°E–100°E, 5°N–40°N, 0.25° grid):
   - MapLibre dark basemap in charcoal/graphite with faint state boundaries (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi NCR, Tamil Nadu, Bengal, etc.).
   - Interactive crosshair coordinate tracker (e.g. 19.076°N, 72.877°E Mumbai).
   - Centered Search Bar with autocomplete for Indian districts & cities (New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Leh, Kochi, Jaipur).

2. GPS Permission & Fallback Modal / Drawer:
   - 'Use Device GPS Location' card with DPDP Act 2023 compliance explanation ('Coordinates processed locally for weather interpolation, zero tracking retention').
   - Permission status toggles: 'Allow Location' / 'Denied (Falling back to manual search/map click)' / 'Acquiring high-accuracy fix (±12m)'.

3. Slide-up Location Drilldown Card (Past · Now · Future):
   - Location: 'Mumbai Colaba Observatory (18.89°N, 72.81°E)'
   - Continuous Past · Now · Future interactive timeline scrubber:
     * Left (Past 24h): ERA5 & IMD AWS observed reanalysis (31.2°C, 114 mm recorded rainfall).
     * Middle ('Now' marker): 29°C, Heavy convective rainfall, 982 hPa, 92% RH.
     * Right (Next 24h-120h): Blended forecast with translucent beige uncertainty band widening from ±0.8°C at +6h to ±2.4°C at +72h.
   - Model Comparison Table:
     * Values for NCUM-G (28.4°C, 95mm), NEPS-G (28.8°C, 88mm), BharatFS (29.1°C, 102mm), GraphCast (29.5°C, 110mm), AIFS (29.2°C, 98mm), and Blended Hybrid (29.0°C, 104mm).
   - Traceability & Lineage hover tooltip:
     * Shows source run 'run_20260924_00', dynamic weights, xESMF 0.25° regrid timestamp, and confidence score.
   - Action buttons: '★ Save Location' | 'Compare with another city' | 'Atmospheric Sounding'.
